messages:
liam_support: Escalating Penumbra Health onboarding — trial tenant hit embed quota + SSO intermittently failing today. Customer is mid-PoC and renewal/contact window in 6 days. Marking P1 for CS handoff.

maria_cs: @liam_support thanks. Can you summarize impact + any mitigation already attempted and send the last error payloads? I want to propose a comms plan if we need to offer a short extension.

liam_support: Quick summary: after a bulk ingest they started seeing 429s for embeddings and users intermittently getting 502 on SSO callback. We throttled ingest and backfilled smaller batches — reduced 429s in staging but production still sporadic. Logs: ```ERROR: embed_rate_limiter: token bucket exhausted for tenant penumbra-tenant-7
TRACE: sso-callback: upstream returned 502 at 2026-03-12T14:02:11Z```

ajay_se: Tagging in. Initial triage suggests two causes: quota misconfiguration on their reserved pool and a spike in parallel tokenization requests from the ingest job. Short-term fix: reduce concurrency + bump embed quota for trial tenant. Command we ran in staging: `redwoodctl quota update --tenant penumbra-tenant-7 --embeddings 2.5x` — validated drop in 429s there. Longer-term: enable prefix caching and add per-client circuit breaker.

support-bot: deploy-bot: rollout 2026-03-12T14:10Z — quota-side patch applied to staging cluster.

liam_support: Applied the concurrency cap on prod ingest (rolled back the heavy batch), still seeing occasional SSO 502s from their IdP. Reached out to their SRE — they said they'll check IdP logs.

sophia_ae: From an account perspective this is high risk — decision: offer a 14-day trial extension + a joint troubleshooting session. I'll draft customer-facing note. We should also offer an enablement session to get them unblocked. cc @maria_cs for comms.

natalie_enablement: I can run a focused enablement workshop tomorrow (30-45m) on ingest patterns and best practices for batching/caching. I'll prepare a short runbook and recording. Recommend we include the following checklist in the comms: 1) temporary concurrency cap steps, 2) how to request quota bump, 3) scheduling the enablement session.

maria_cs: Proposed comms plan: (a) Immediate note acknowledging impact + our mitigation steps, (b) Offer 14-day extension + enablement session, (c) follow-up with a technical summary and expected timeline. @sophia_ae please approve wording. I'll create a tidied SMS/email + Zendesk macro.

sophia_ae: Approved. Suggested copy snippet: "We're sorry for the disruption — we've applied a temporary cap to reduce errors and are scheduling a joint troubleshooting call. We will extend your trial by 14 days while we resolve root cause." Add contact window and next steps.

maria_cs: Action items: liam_support — paste any additional prod logs in this thread; ajay_se — put quota bump into infra change request for prod and own rollback plan; natalie_enablement — confirm workshop time; sophia_ae — confirm extension and update AE notes. I'll send the customer message once we have logs and the workshop slot.

liam_support: Pasting last 2 prod errors now. Also confirmed their SRE will join the call at 17:00 UTC.

ajay_se: Filed infra CR: REDWOOD-CR-22091, target change window 17:30 UTC, rollback: revert quota delta. I'll monitor the rollout and post results here.

support-bot: alert-bot: incident note created: #INC-2026-0312-penumbra — severity P1 assigned.

maria_cs: Great — thanks everyone. I'll draft the comms and post for review in ~15min. Please react with :thumbsup: when you approve the final message.

sophia_ae: :thumbsup:

natalie_enablement: :thumbsup:
